title: Angle rolls and section benders
subtitle: PK motorized benders · HPK 40 – 120 hydraulic section and pipe benders · HPK DP heavy-duty beam benders to HEB 600 · TC-42 NC coiler
about_title: Angle, pipe, tube and beam bent into rings, arcs and spirals
about_text: The machines in this catalogue are NovoTech's premium line: built in Turkey to NovoTech's specification by a CE-certified metal-forming plant with more than 40 years of machine building and exports to over 100 countries, with European hydraulic and electrical components, inspected before shipping, and sold under NovoTech's name with a CSA-approved panel, a 1-year warranty and spare parts and technical support from NovoTech in Mississauga, Ontario.

An angle roll pushes a bar, angle, pipe, tube or beam between three rolls to bend it into an arc, a ring or a spiral. The PK 30 and PK 35 are the motorized benders for small flat bar, angle and tube; the hydraulic HPK 40 to HPK 120 add digital readouts, hydraulic guide rolls and optional NC control for section and pipe to 6″ Schedule 40; the HPK DP heavy-duty benders roll channel, I-beam and H-beam up to HEB 600; and the TC-42 NC coiling machine winds tube into variable-pitch coils. Every machine rolls horizontally or vertically and ships with a standard roll set; pipe, tube, angle and special profile rolls are available for all of them.
